title: Survival singleplayer/multiplayer
description: Great Vanilla+ modpack with optimazation, voxy, shaders and smaller items.
body:
Enhance your Minecraft world with the ultimate lightweight and visually stunning experience.This carefully curated modpack delivers maximum performance and breathtaking visuals without bloating your game files. It is designed specifically for players who want a beautiful, ultra-smooth, and clean gameplay experience right out of the box, making it perfect for both survival adventures and creative building.

🌟 Key Features

Optimization: Say goodbye to lag spikes. Enjoy high FPS and ultra-smooth gameplay with industry-leading performance mods tailored for almost any computer system.

Voxy Rendering: Experience advanced voxel-based modern performance that optimizes world rendering, making chunk loading seamless and efficient.

Built-in Shaders: Get breathtaking lighting, realistic shadows, atmospheric fog, and vibrant colors instantly without needing manual configuration.

Smaller Items: Clean, downsized 3D item models that greatly clear up your valuable screen space, ensuring your field of view is never blocked during combat or building.

Essential mod: Join your friends world wtih Essential. Maximum is 8 player and you don't need to be on same network.
